notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
We've got good news!
The demo has appeared in Steam on the main page of the app!

Also changes have been made:

1. Added functionality to discharge torch batteries. Now you need to look for batteries to avoid finding yourself in total darkness.

2. Added additional elements reacting to the presence of the player.

3. Changed models, textures, sounds, lighting.

4. Redesigned UI interface.

5. Hotfixes and bug fixes.

We are waiting for your feedback and suggestions on improving the game!
